scope: Standalone full Pending Queue research and decomposition; no implementation or live-account operations

research.title: Fix Habitica tag coverage for projects and task organization

disposition.reason: Promote four bounded units for persistent tag identity, separately scoped gateway operations, complete membership reconciliation and browser/agent recovery; native tag deletion and score effects are excluded.

research.title: Fix default task projection and agent reward guidance

disposition.reason: Promote authoritative prospective Todo policy and coordinated browser/agent defaults. Existing immutable journals, local capture, consent and uncertain-outcome fences remain explicit.

research.title: Fix projection-only linking without artificial task edits

disposition.reason: Promote a typed unchanged-task repair command and a separate UI/recovery unit. Historical completion repair requires verified identity or explicit review rather than synthetic completed fields or automatic reward backfill.

research.title: Restore Habitica creation coverage for Dailies and Habits

disposition.reason: Promote separate Habit and lossless Daily creation units. Reuse the existing linked-Daily schedule task and make shared creation normalization a prerequisite instead of duplicating schedule authoring.

research.title: Fix incomplete project conversion and linked source retirement

disposition.reason: Promote resumable source-item identity conversion, browser/agent conversion journeys and separately reviewed linked-source retirement. Retain the legacy source until every replacement and historical-state decision is verified.

research.title: Recover bulk spell casting and gear restoration under rate limits

disposition.reason: Existing adaptive pacing already covers serialized API dispatch. Promote truthful stage/outcome reporting and durable bounded equipment recovery for missing cancellation cleanup and swallowed restoration failure; do not rebuild pacing.

research.title: Support stable project aliases in browser and agent workflows

disposition.reason: Promote canonical alias identity/uniqueness and separate browser/agent journeys using an explicit workspace-local normalization policy.

research.title: Interpret natural deadline shorthand in ChatGPT and Codex

disposition.reason: Promote multilingual deadline shorthand/date interpretation over existing exact fields, with explicit timezone/year rules and separate host qualification; no notification delivery or duplicate parser is implied.

research.title: Identify installed plugin versions and backend compatibility

disposition.reason: Promote backend compatibility discovery and traceable later package releases. Installed host identity remains unknown without actual package/host evidence; no current production publication follows.

research.title: Add account-bound Markdown notes with agent workflows

disposition.reason: Promote four bounded Notes units for local model/storage, separately consented cloud service, agent tools and safe browser authoring. Personal notes remain separate from task projections and old grants.

research.title: Default the equipment optimizer to Intelligence for every class

disposition.reason: Promote the targeted Intelligence preference change; current defaults remain Balanced, all alternate goals remain available and opening the optimizer must not equip gear.
Promote only missing project-filtered retained history/navigation, and reuse existing dedicated statistics and extended-recovery tasks. Existing search/date/history behavior is not reimplemented.

materialFindings: AdaptiveRequestPacer and the API dispatch gate already exist; missing spell cleanup and outcome classification remain independently actionable.
Normal task projection defaults, recurring creation, missing organization tags and linked-source retirement remain incomplete.
Ordinary create/update cannot import protected completed/dateCompleted fields; historical correspondence repair must not silently score completed work.
Task priority already supports Low/Normal/High/Urgent; the optimizer still defaults to Balanced.
Current history has search/date filters and restoration; project filtering is missing.
No independent Notes model/API or project alias field exists.
MCP handshake and package manifest both hardcode 0.1.0 but provide no trusted installed-host package identity.
adoptedDefaults: Preserve account consent, offline capture, immutable receipts and unknown-outcome fences.
Tag writes require explicit additive authority; no old native organization permission silently gains upstream writes.
Tag mapping uses canonical identity; archived provenance remains retained and remote tags are never deleted automatically.
Aliases are optional normalized workspace-local identities, including retained archived collisions.
Relative dates use explicit timezone/current civil date; yearless dates choose the next non-past occurrence.
Independent Notes use explicit cloud opt-in, narrow note scopes, private revisioned source and recoverable trash until explicit purge.
Plugin version work belongs to a later release; unknown installed versions remain unknown.

externalReferences.finding: Own-task creation accepts native kinds. Task-tag changes and deletion use explicit routes and ownership checks; task deletion cannot be represented as native archive alone.
Native tags have create/read/update/delete operations; deleting a tag removes user task references, so automatic tag deletion is excluded.
Daily fields include frequency/everyX/startDate/repeat/daysOfMonth and unsupported variants. completed/dateCompleted are protected noSet fields.
Task creation sanitizes input before constructing a native task and normalizes Daily start dates.
Model sanitization removes protected noSet fields from ordinary task creation/update payloads.
Portable manifests contain package versions; installed local copies can differ from source. Package evidence is separate from the remote MCP server.
Fresh conversations and actual tool/skill discovery qualify host availability; server connection does not establish installed skill identity.
Server tool updates differ from package metadata/skill updates, which require a new package/version publication path.

checks.pendingSelection: all 12 resolved through helper before research

limitations: Official source URLs use upstream develop at observation time; implementation must revalidate endpoint behavior.
Synthetic contract planning does not establish physical-device, installed-client or live-operation acceptance.
Historical task repair can require a concrete user decision before a real game effect; local implementation can expose and test the refusal/review path.
Previous implementation checkpoint remains stopped; new nonblocking tasks stay outside the frozen snapshot.
